fields.label: Main Account
fields.description: An account the Account Set driver reads, expanded: a group account on the driver is stored as one row for itself and one per descendant.

fields.label: Declared Account
fields.description: The account as listed on the driver; Main Account is it or one of its descendants.

fields.label: Value Sign
fields.description: As Booked or Reversed, as the driver declared it when the run was computed.
